goal: Install portable workflows and reconcile pinned upstream changes deliberately.
invariants: Existing adaptations are never overwritten by install/sync.
Unsupported CLI action flags fail before repository mutation or execution; only init accepts dry-run.
Skills testing, doctor and audit use one core-owned semantic validator against the installed pack’s own pins.
Reconciliation candidates pass the same strict metadata, workflow, source-provenance and exact-license contract before writes; staging independently verifies complete source bytes.
acceptance: Offline install validates pinned source, metadata and exact license text, preserves existing adaptation bytes and is idempotent across repeated CLI invocations.
Sync stages changed source/supporting references without overwriting adaptations; reconcile rejects malformed, stale or unapproved disposition/license inputs before writes.
Skills CLI, doctor and audit apply one semantic validator, so a rejected installed pack cannot earn skills capability.
